newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan petrol retail price flat, kerosene up - survey.
newsitem.headline: Japan petrol retail price flat, kerosene up - survey.

text.p: Japan's average gasoline price as of August 10 was 105 yen per litre, unchanged from the same period a month earlier, according to a survey by the private Oil Information Service Centre unveiled on Tuesday.

Retail prices in some suburban areas eased as gasoline stands crowded into the area continued their price competition, even though wholesale prices were higher reflecting strong crude oil prices, said an official at the centre.
Various taxes account for more than half of the gasoline retail price.
As of August 10, the nationwide retail price of kerosene, used for heating, averaged 855 yen per 18 litres, up two yen from a month earlier, the survey showed.
Kerosene retail prices are expected to continue rising towards the winter peak demand season, the official said.
Possible imports by trading houses, which are said to be eyeing kerosene imports, are likely to cap a sharp rise, he said.
The national average retail price of gas oil, used as fuel in buses, trucks and taxis, was unchanged for the sixth consecutive month at 81 yen per litre, the survey showed.
